level_description: Multi-Spec Cascades & Kahn Topological Inversion (Nested specs, cross-object member resolution via dot-notation, and fields declared in reverse topological dependency order)

L3_cloud_cluster_quote.name: Multi-Tier Cloud Cluster Infrastructure Quote
L3_cloud_cluster_quote.description: Evaluates nested compute and storage specifications. Aggregated bill and composite sub-costs are declared first, requiring Kahn's topological sort to reorder resolution to downstream node metrics.

prompts.system: You are an automated provisioning orchestrator configuring enterprise Kubernetes cluster quotes. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate an enterprise cluster configuration quote with valid node hardware profiles and persistent storage tiers. Calculate all dependent costs accurately.

ram_gb.description: Memory allocation per node (must be >= vcpu_cores * 2.0)

L3_clinical_drug_dosage.name: Clinical Pharmacokinetics & Weight-Tiered Regimen
L3_clinical_drug_dosage.description: Calculates weight-adjusted therapeutic dosages from nested patient biometrics. Total daily dose and per-administration limits are inverted ahead of base patient measurements.

prompts.system: You are a clinical pharmacokinetics dosing calculator generating verified prescription regimens. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a verified prescription dosage regimen for an adult patient. Derive safe per-kilogram weight adjustments and determine total daily dose.

dose_per_kg_mg.description: Prescribed mg per kg of body weight

L3_portfolio_rebalance.name: Quantitative Portfolio Rebalance & Fee Schedule
L3_portfolio_rebalance.description: Rebalances capital across equity and bond sub-allocations. Combined execution fees and individual transaction levies are declared before portfolio capital parameters.

prompts.system: You are a quantitative portfolio management system generating rebalancing trade allocations. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a portfolio rebalance schedule across asset classes. Specify allocation percentages, calculate transaction costs for each tier, and provide the total execution fee.

total_portfolio_usd.description: Total assets under management (AUM) in USD
